title: chore: update app metrics 2026-09-29
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden counts itself
gist.blurb: The daily app-metrics refresh landed. Even gardens have spreadsheets.
gist.summary: The automated September 29 update refreshed app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json, keeping the app-management data current.
gist.impact: Maintainers have an up-to-date snapshot of app requests and repository metrics; there is no change to the user-facing API or site.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the daily metrics refresh as Polli tending a garden of app-shaped code-plants, with a retro monitor displaying simple request and repository counters. Give Polli a tiny bookkeeper's visor; the scene should feel like a quiet maintenance task, not a product launch.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel garden workspace, a retro monitor glows lime green (#ecf874) with simple app request and repository counters while Polli, wearing a tiny bookkeeper's visor, checks the figures beside blooming code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky sprites, warm cream tones, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
